Kimi to Boku no Saigo no Senjo, Aruiwa Sekai ga Hajimaru Seisen
description:
Embroiled in a hundred-year war, young Iska is sent to assassinate the Ice Calamity Witch, Aliceliese. Meant to murder each other, their initial encounter on the battleground creates doubt in their missions, but finding common ground together would make them traitors to their own countries. Though circumstances previously made them enemies, their now conflicted hearts may just make them lovers!

(Source: Funimation)

name.native: アリスリーゼ・ルゥ・ネビュリス9世

node.description:
Aliceliese is a calm person and a kind heart to which she uses mostly to protect her family legacy. While she comes off as a cold fighter when she's on the battlefield, Aliceliese isn't much different from a normal girl her age. She enjoys going to the opera (having cried during one play), and is a fan of art and can be very talkative at times.

Being a teenage girl, Alice has some interest in the opposite sex. Not having many males her age around her, she expresses most of this interest in [Iska](https://anilist.co/character/170215/Iska) when they're not on the battlefield. She even treats their rivalry as something similar to a relationship, as [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/180987/Vispose-Rin) compared the way she was planning for their final battle to planning for a wedding.

Iska is the main protagonist of the series. He is the current wielder of the Astral Swords and is determined to end what he considers a pointless war. 

He was the youngest Saint Disciple to ever receive the title; but after releasing a "witch" from captivity, he was stripped of his rank and imprisoned for life. Circumstances around the war against the Nebulis Sovereignty have led to his release, but his goals haven't changed. 

Iska has a moral code that doesn’t discriminate, even if a supposed enemy is at hand. He shows kindness and bravery, despite putting himself at risk, and even willing to risk committing treason for them. On the battlefield, Iska becomes very fierce yet also calm, not being afraid of whatever power his opponent has or taking dangerous gambles to protect himself from their attacks. However, Iska usually avoids cutting down most opponents when he doesn't see any value in doing so, simply knocking them out. This has led Iska to be known as a 'peace-loving war nut'.

(Source: KimiSen Wiki)

Mismis is a supporting character in KimiSen. She is the captain of the 907th unit belonging to Iska's squad. She can be seen as a cute yet highly supportive teammate since her fighting skills are subpar to the other characters in her squad. Even though that she isn't highly smart with combat, she is usually the morale booster of their team, and gives everyone the emotional support that they need. She was formerly a human until she was sucked into the vortex where she got exposed. Her power included nullifying every astral mage's to use their abilities whenever she uses hers.

Being  the oldest person in their group, she acts and looks childish as she contains many stuff animals and cute dresses in her room. She also considers herself to be a girl rather than a woman and doesn't like it people call her a child.

Jhin is part of the 907th unit and serves as a sniper. He is shown to be a calm and collected individual, along with being the smartest among them. He usually makes sarcastic remarks, often making a witty remark, but he tends to care a lot for his comrades in his squad.

~!Jhin was selected by Crosswell to find the successor of the sword. Due to the reason that Jhin was good in range, Crosswell awsn't able to teach him other than the gun theory since Crosswell's specialty was being a swordsman. It means that Jhin would have to work hard with perseverance if he wants to learn how to wield the strongest swords that Crosswell wanted to find a successor. Ultimately, it was then that Iska and Jhin knew each other and became best friends.!~

Nene is a supporting character of the anime KimiSen. Along with Jhin, Iska and Mismis, they make up the members of the 907th unit with her specialty being able to graph coordinates of her target to a machine and releasing out projectiles to her enemies. She is a cheerful and high spirited girl that will help her teammates even if they go into such troubles, such as when Mismis became an Astral Mage after being exposed to a spirit vortex. She usually sees Iska as her brother and has a close relationship with her squad. Her weapons includes an anti-astral power grenade that disrupts the use of astral powers in a defined range, and has a ring that can indicate the position of her target.

シスベル・ルゥ・ネビュリス9世

node.description:
Sisbell is the third princess after [Aliceliese](https://anilist.co/character/170214/) and [Elletear](https://anilist.co/character/198582/) of the Nebulis Sovereignty.

Prior to the start of the anime, [Iska](https://anilist.co/character/170215/) and Sisbell knew each other when he freed her from the hands of the Heavenly Empire. After saving her from them, she found out that Iska was treated as a prisoner for being a traitor to the country. She was in disbelief at how he went on his way to treat a princess and stated that Sisbel only had weak astral power and was a little girl. With determination, she set out to find the whereabouts of her fated "dream knight" just to be captured by Lord Mask. Though, in the end of the anime, it was seen that Iska was being fought over by Alice and Sisbell, with Sisbell making a statement that he would be the perfect knight for the next queen.

name.native: イリーティア・ルゥ・ネビュリス9

node.description:
Elletear is one of the princesses and the older sister to Alice and Sisbell. She dons a heterochromatic eye where her left eye is colored Gold, her right eye contains a Light Blue hue, and in the manga, she has green eyes.

~!Inside her personality that appears to look like a responsible among the princesses, she hides under a bravado where she's a manipulative individual that is trying to overthrow her mother who is also the Queen of the Sovereignty due to being neglected in the past and being treated as an individual with weak sense of astral power. Because of that, she will go out of her way to feed false information to the masked Man just so that her plan would succeed. Additionally, she is also an accomplice and acts as the main antagonist along with the eight great apostles who raised an attack against an independent nation should they either side with them or the sovereignty.!~

node.description: The treasured child of the Zoa family. A thorn astral mage able to unleash countless black needles, she can both destroy all that she pierces and reconstruct it. Her power is said to exceed even that of Alice. She is emotionless and prone to mumbling.
